# Subway Builder - Stuttgart Map

---

## Description:
> Bring the subway to Stuttgart! Build a working subway network in the capital of Baden-Württemberg/Germany. Almost 500.000 commuters want to go to their workplace and it's your job to get them there! Based on real-life demand data from [mobilithek.info](https://mobilithek.info/offers/767359761906577408) (Latest access: 6th July 2026).
## Features:
- **Size**: 28x34km / 956.5sq/km
- **Real data**: Real-world demand data from mobilithek.info, utilizing the official 1x1km statistical grid.
- **Real routes and volume**: Commuter routes and their volume are strictly derived from the statistical data of the German Government (BMV/Mobilithek).
- **Demand Accuracy**: Macro-level grid demand is paired with OpenStreetMap (OSM) building data, anchoring the statistical commuter numbers to real-world physical starting points and destinations.
- **In-Game data**: 494,428 residents | 494,428 jobs
data_source: BMV, (OMS - only for exact building locations to map demand)
